source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch CoralTemp daily 5-km SST, ERDDAP dataset noaacrwsstDaily
spatial_pixels: same frozen 163 NOAA grid pixels in identical order
period: target start >=2026-01-01; include every forecast origin whose full 30-day target is available at acquisition cutoff
history: use 2025 frozen history plus acquired 2026 SST; input ends at forecast origin
preprocessing: reuse 2000-2017 climatology365, SSTA scale, and pixel DAP rho without recalibration
statistical_test: paired 60-day moving-block bootstrap across forecast origins; 10000 replicates; seeds fixed
missing_data: abort evaluation if any required selected-pixel SST is nonfinite; do not impute based on test outcomes
decision: report result regardless of direction; no model changes or selection based on 2026
